items.note: Unique ids, sections, related refs, detail files, md in sync. goals.md: traps, now/next/later lines, counts for wayLater/maybe.

items.note: Installed by init. Pre-commit runs upgo check for every upgo project in the repo; Claude hook blocks Edit/Write on schema-tagged goals.json and goals.md.

items.note: 127.0.0.1 only, custom header plus Origin check on mutations, projects by registry id, fs.watch pushes SSE. Vite dev port trusted only with UPGO_DEV=1.

items.title: Review hardening pass
items.note: goals.md written first so retries cannot double-add, lock cleanup never fails a write, init checks the registry first, CRLF purpose fix, list --search matches values only.

items.title: Related chips jump to the item
items.body: Related refs render as plain chips. App already opens a project at an item (`select(id, item)`), so a click can jump there, across projects too. Size S.
items.note: Related chips are buttons: same project jumps locally (shows closed items), other project opens it at the item, unknown project or item toasts

items.title: Render markdown in the dashboard
items.body: Bodies and detail files are markdown but show as plain text and a raw pre block, so backticks, lists and links read badly. A small sanitized markdown renderer (no raw HTML) for body and detail. Size M.
items.note: web/src/goals/Markdown.tsx: React-element renderer (headings, lists incl nested, code, fences, quotes, hr, bold/em, http/mailto links only). Used for item body, detail file, suggestions, traps. Test: tests/web/markdown.test.tsx

items.title: Undo toast for dashboard actions
items.body: Done, drop, phase change, move and delete have no undo besides git. An Undo button on the success toast that sends the inverse op: old status and note, old phase, move back next to the old neighbor, re-add the deleted item. Size M.
items.note: Undo on the success toast for done, drop, reopen, phase/status, move (menu, keys, drag) and delete; inverse ops in web/src/goals/undo.ts, a newer undo toast replaces the older one, re-added items keep their created date

items.title: upgo suggestion promote
items.body: Turning a suggestion into a goal from the CLI takes `upgo add` plus `upgo suggestion delete`, and the second step is easy to forget, so finished ideas linger in the panel. `upgo suggestion promote <id> --section N [--phase ..]` does both, reusing title and body. Size S.
items.note: upgo suggestion promote <id> --section N [--phase ..] adds the goal from title and body, then deletes the suggestion

items.title: Broken suggestions.json should not break the project
items.body: If suggestions.json is invalid, GET /api/projects/:id fails and the whole project shows an error instead of its goals. Have the server return the goals with a suggestions error shown in the panel, and have upgo check validate suggestions.json too.
items.note: Server returns goals plus suggestionsError shown in the Suggestions panel; upgo check reports a broken suggestions.json
